messages:
marie: Quick heads-upwe're going to emit "session_probe" events from the edge to improve SLA watermarks. They'll look like usage events but should not affect invoices. tagging billing + eng-platform
devin: Can you show the event payload? want to be sure invoice preview won't surface them
marie: payload example: POST /ingest {
  "event_type": "session_probe",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "route_id": "r-web",
  "probe_id": "probe:edge-2:998",
  "meta": {"marker": "internal_probe"}
} We'll set marker=internal_probe so ledger/preview can filter
raj: prefer a dedicated field like billable=false instead of burying in meta. cheaper to reason about in SQL filters
marie: ok we can add billable=false + marker. reason we used marker is for backwards compat with existing parsers
devin: Important: invoice-staging must drop billable=false before aggregation. also invoice-preview UI should hide these events by default and show a short banner "internal probes hidden"
raj: Add canary: 0.5% tenants for 1h, emit metric metering.session_probe.count{canary=true} and an alert if invoice-preview shows any delta in cost lines
deploy-bot: marie/session-probe-canary deployed to edge-2 cluster 2026-03-21T12:05Z
billing-bot: ALERT: edge-2 event vol +2.7% vs baseline (probe traffic) -- verifying preview pipeline
marie: canary looks stable, dedupe collisions=0. I've opened ENG-5901 with rollout notes and the reconcile script probe-reconcile.sh for any accidental rows
devin: please add unit tests in ledger-builder that assert billable=false rows are dropped and add an integration test for backfill replay
raj: UI task: preview param ignore_internal=true default, opt-in show_internal for power users
marie: will do runbook + dashboards. will post status after 5% ramp. thanks :thumbsup:
